name: Tran Hung Dao
lore: Vietnam's greatest military hero, who defeated the Mongol Empire three times. His 'Proclamation to Officers' remains a masterpiece of military literature. He is revered as a national saint.

abilities.name: Mongol Bane
abilities.description: Tran Hung Dao deals +30% damage to units with higher HP than himself.

abilities.name: River Ambush
abilities.description: Plants 3 hidden stake traps in a line. Enemy units that walk over them take 80 damage and are slowed 50% for 4 seconds.

abilities.name: Bach Dang Tide
abilities.description: Calls a tidal surge on all water/coastal tiles in a 300-tile radius. Enemy units on those tiles take 150 damage and are stunned for 3 seconds.
